question: Out of the five tributaries of the Indus which are called 'Panchnad', which of the following completely drains the Indian territory unlike others which enter Pakistan?
solution:
The correct answer is '**Beas**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Beas river** originates from **Rohtang Pass in Himachal Pradesh**.

 
 
• The river is only** 470 kilometers long**, located completely in Indian territory. 
 
• The river is also **infamous for a tragedy **in which 24 engineering students and 1 tour guide drowned when the doors of **Largi Dam** were opened on 8 June 2014.
 
• **The drainage basin of Beas is 20,303 square kilometers large**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ravi** river originates from **Kullu Hills near Rohtang Pass in Himachal Pradesh**.

 
 
• It flows into Pakistan plains before emptying into the Chenab river.
 
 
 
• **Jhelum **river originates from** Verinag in Jammu and Kashmir.**
 
 
• It flows in Pakistan territory before connecting to the Chenab river.
 
 
 
• **Satluj** river orignates from **Kailash Mountain**.
 
 
• Satluj is also sometimes known as the **Red River**.
 
 
 
• Chenab River originates from Baralacha Pass in Himachal Pradesh.
 
 
• It’s the largest tributary of the Indus river (In terms of Drain).
 
• It is also known as the Chandrabhaga River.
 
• It is a major river that flows in India and Pakistan.
